top_choice_rationale: The magic-wavelength optical lattice is a distinct, physically clean idea beyond the 2005 comb and 2012 single-ion control prizes. It is reproduced at the 1e-18 level by several independent laboratories, resolves gravitational redshift over millimetres and opened many-body clock physics. Katori and Ye are a clean two-name allocation, and the citation rests on the lattice concept and its realization, not on the redefinition of the second. P002 is a credible but less mature second choice, since the pairing mechanism, sample variability and Yuan Cao's omission leave the three-name allocation contestable. Both are preferable to no award.
recusal_note: none apparent for P001 or P002 from profile; as WACQT director working on superconducting circuits I would recuse on circuit QED (B024), which is not in this slate.
